summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco CurrencyShares Swiss Franc Trust (FXF) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the U.S. Dollar per Swiss Franc index. The fund tracks the changes in value of the Swiss franc relative to the US dollar. FXF was launched on Jun 21, 2006 and is issued by Invesco.
